name: audience-detection
description: Detect who the response is for and adjust tone/depth accordingly. Technical peer gets terse code-focused answers. Stakeholder gets context and impact framing.

question.instructions: Based on the prompt and context, who is the likely audience for the response?

criteria.self: Eugene working solo — terse, skip explanations, just do the thing
criteria.technical-peer: Another engineer — show code, skip business context, be direct
criteria.tech-lead: Engineering lead or architect — balance code with design rationale
criteria.product: Product manager or designer — explain impact, skip implementation details
criteria.stakeholder: Executive or cross-functional stakeholder — focus on outcomes, timeline, risk
criteria.external: External documentation, PR description, or public-facing text

question.instructions: How formal should the tone be?
